Based on the provided results, the following insurance plans are recommended:

  1. Click 2 Protect Super:
    • High claim settlement percentage (99.50%)
    • Instant claim settlement (24 hrs)
    • Competitive monthly premium (496/M)
  2. Smart Secure Plus - Life Cover:
    • Very high claim settlement percentage (99.65%)
    • Instant claim settlement (One day)
    • Competitive monthly premium (469/M)
  3. iProtect Smart Lumpsum Plan:
    • High claim settlement percentage (99.17%)
    • Instant claim settlement (ClaimForSure - One day)
    • Competitive monthly premium (539/M)

Factors to consider when choosing an insurance plan:

  • Claim settlement percentage: This indicates the percentage of the claim amount that will be paid out in the event of a claim.
  • Instant claim settlement: This refers to the speed at which the insurance company will process and pay out a claim.
  • Monthly premium: This is the amount you will pay each month to maintain your insurance coverage.
  • Coverage till: This indicates the number of years the insurance coverage will last.

Additional considerations:

  • Health status: Your individual health status may affect the cost and availability of insurance plans.
  • Lifestyle factors: Your smoking and drinking habits can also impact your insurance premiums.
  • Coverage options: Consider any additional coverage options such as critical illness or hospital cash benefits.

Recommendations for your specific situation:

Since you are young (age 22), you have a long term to accumulate wealth. This allows you to afford a slightly higher premium for a plan with a higher claim settlement percentage and instant claim settlement.
